verdict.rationale: Sentry's first-party docs show official SDKs that capture errors automatically for mobile and backend platforms: Android, Apple via sentry-cocoa, Dart, .NET and Elixir. Automatic uncaught-error capture for a web frontend (browser JavaScript) is not explicitly documented; only a source-maps page title hints at JavaScript support, so the story is not fully covered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a browser/web-frontend SDK that automatically captures uncaught errors, and independent or hands-on corroboration of automatic capture across all three tiers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument my web frontend, backend services, and mobile apps with official SDKs that capture uncaught errors automatically
